notes: The italicized *and* is `added`: the Hebrew writes no conjunction morpheme between אַדִּירִים and עָם (rules 14, 30).
אַדִּירִים takes its supplied *the* as an anarthrous substantival adjective (rule 46), while עָם takes one as an ordinary supplied determiner (rule 15).
Several marginal construals are printed for this verse; all were read and set aside, the printed text governing (rule 38).
